pageDescription: Keigan's root cause analysis, evidence, blast radius and communications for an incident.

header.rerunStartedDescription: The previous analysis is kept. This page now shows the new run.
header.rerunFailed: Could not start a new run

feedback.title: Was this root cause right?
feedback.description: Your verdict helps Keigan recognise recurring issues for this application.

verdictHelp.correct: The leading hypothesis matches what we found.
verdictHelp.partially_correct: Part of it is right, or the fix needed changes.

progress.title: Keigan is investigating
progress.description: Evidence is collected by queries Keigan runs itself; AI interprets it afterwards.

rca.evidenceOnlyDescription: The AI service was unavailable or its daily budget was used up, so only evidence, the blast radius and the timeline were produced. Re-run the investigation later for the analysis.
rca.failedDescription: Re-run the investigation, or contact a Keigan admin if it fails again.
rca.emptyEvidenceOnly: Open the Evidence tab to see what Keigan found.
rca.emptyDescription: The root cause analysis appears here when the investigation completes.
rca.suggestOnly: Keigan suggests; people decide and act.
rca.matchedRunbooksHelp: Known issues that fit the symptoms and evidence.

hypotheses.intro: Three analysts examined the same evidence from different angles. Confidence is calibrated: 80% or more needs direct evidence and matching timing.
hypotheses.highRisk: High risk: confirm with change process
hypotheses.highRiskCommand: High risk: confirm with your change process before running.

evidence.intro: Queries ran over {{window}} and over a baseline window of the same length just before it. Personal data is masked.
evidence.emptyDescription: Evidence appears here once Keigan has queried the application's services.
evidence.injectionDescription: Some log text looked like instructions to an AI. It was quoted as data and never followed.

blast.emptyDescription: The impact map appears when the investigation has finished mapping dependencies.
blast.graphDescription: Direct: showing failure signals. Indirect: depends on a failing service.
blast.noSlos: No SLO is currently at risk for this application.
blast.noStakeholders: No stakeholders are subscribed to the impacted services.
blast.healthySlos_one: {{count}} other SLO for these services is healthy.
blast.healthySlos_other: {{count}} other SLOs for these services are healthy.

alerts.emptyDescription: This investigation did not start from an alert group.
alerts.decisionsDescription: How the alert pipeline treated each alert on the way to this group.

communications.policy: Drafts are written from verified findings. Sending needs an application admin's approval, except the preliminary report when automatic sending is on.
communications.subject: Subject
communications.generating: Drafting. It will appear in a moment.
communications.emptyDescription: Generate a draft to prepare a message for stakeholders.
communications.emptyRunning: Drafts are prepared when the analysis completes.

postmortem.noIncidentDescription: Postmortems are written for incidents. This investigation is not linked to one.
postmortem.emptyResolved: Generate a blameless postmortem from the incident, investigation, timeline and communications.
postmortem.emptyOpen: Use "{{action}}" above to close the incident and write the postmortem together. This button only writes a draft now and leaves the incident open.
postmortem.generatingDescription: Keigan is combining the incident, timeline, chat facts and communications.
postmortem.failedTitle: The postmortem could not be generated
postmortem.failedDescription: Try again later or write it by hand.
postmortem.draftHelp: AI-written draft. Review, edit and finalise before sharing.
postmortem.finalizeDescription: A finalised postmortem can no longer be edited or regenerated.

resolve.title: Resolve this incident
resolve.description: Marks the incident resolved in Keigan and in ServiceNow, and sends a resolution update draft for approval.
resolve.noteHelp: What fixed it? Keigan uses this in the postmortem.
resolve.generatePostmortemHelp: A blameless draft you can edit before it is shared.

chat.title: Investigation chat
chat.subtitle: Grounded in this investigation · reads only
chat.intro: Ask about the evidence, the hypotheses or the next step. Keigan can run read-only follow-up queries.

prompts.whatChanged: What changed in the last hour?
prompts.executiveUpdate: Draft a status update for executives
prompts.explainNewEngineer: Explain this to a new engineer

teams.title: Teams room
teams.description: The incident chat for this incident appears here once the Teams integration is available.

outcome.label: Outcome

inconclusive.title: Inconclusive
inconclusive.description: The evidence does not settle between the explanations. The strongest lead is shown, not confirmed.

cause_not_visible.title: Cause not visible in the data Keigan can see
cause_not_visible.description: Nothing Keigan could read changed against the hour before. The cause is likely in a system or change Keigan cannot see.

outcome.notRecorded: This investigation ran before Keigan recorded outcomes.
outcome.guardNote: Keigan's rules changed the AI's conclusion from {{proposed}} to {{final}}: {{reason}}.

guard.nothing_changed_in_checked_sources: nothing Keigan could read changed against the baseline
guard.leading_hypothesis_not_supported: the leading explanation was not supported by the evidence
guard.synthesis_unavailable: the AI summary was not available

guard.support_not_in_evidence: none of the evidence it cites changed against the baseline
guard.confidence_below_supported_minimum: the confidence was below the minimum for a supported explanation
guard.rule_out_not_in_evidence: no evidence that was read shows this lens is healthy
guard.confidence_above_ruled_out_maximum: the confidence was too high to rule it out

hypothesisState.guardNote: The AI said {{proposed}}; Keigan's rules changed it to {{final}}: {{reason}}.

ruledOut.title: Ruled out
ruledOut.description: Explanations that the evidence ruled out, and why.

coverage.title: What Keigan could not check
coverage.description: Sources Keigan could not read and checks it did not make. A check that was not made is not a healthy result.
coverage.empty: Keigan read every source it planned to.
coverage.footnote: Keigan does not read code repositories or deployment pipelines.
coverage.legacyEvidence: Shown as evidence {{code}} in this older investigation

kind.changes_not_readable: Recent deployments and configuration changes could not be read
kind.service_without_telemetry: {{service}} has no log or metric source connected, so nothing was checked for it
kind.services_beyond_limit: {{count}} service(s) were not examined because of the limit of {{limit}}: {{services}}
kind.checks_beyond_limit: {{count}} check(s) on {{service}} were not run because of the limit of {{limit}} per service
kind.planned_query_rejected: A query the AI planned for {{service}} was refused by the query safety rules
kind.planned_query_failed: A query the AI planned for {{service}} failed
kind.results_left_out: {{count}} low-signal result(s) were left out to stay within the evidence budget
kind.perspective_not_analysed: The {{perspective}} analysis produced no usable result

reason.access_refused: Keigan's identity was refused access (a read role is missing)
reason.throttled: the source was busy and asked Keigan to slow down
reason.timed_out: the source took too long to answer
reason.not_approved: this source is not approved for this application
reason.query_rejected: the query safety rules refused the query
reason.reader_not_available: Keigan cannot read this kind of tool yet
reason.ai_unavailable: the AI model was not available
reason.ai_output_invalid: the AI's reply could not be used
reason.unknown: for a reason Keigan could not identify

baseline.no_baseline_for_source: No baseline for this kind of source

evidenceCheck.introUnreadSources: Sources Keigan could not read are listed on the Root cause tab.

trace.title: Decision trace
trace.description: What Keigan did, in order, and why: its inputs, every AI call with what went in and what came out, what Keigan's own checks changed, and the outcome.
trace.notRecorded: This investigation ran before Keigan kept decision traces. Only its AI usage is shown.
trace.incomplete: Part of this trace could not be recorded. The investigation itself was not affected.
trace.running: Still running: steps appear as they finish.
trace.loadFailed: The decision trace could not be loaded.

decision.synthesis_fallback: Fell back from the AI summary

aiCall.nothingChanged: Keigan's checks changed nothing in this answer.
aiCall.rawAdminsOnly: Raw AI answers are visible to application admins.

adjustment.invalid_citations_removed: Removed citations that do not exist: {{codes}}
adjustment.evidence_codes_dropped: Dropped evidence codes that do not exist: {{codes}}
adjustment.file_path_replaced: Replaced {{count}} file path(s) not found in the knowledge
adjustment.command_risk_raised: Raised the fix risk from {{from}} to {{to}}
adjustment.confidence_capped: Capped the overall confidence from {{from}} to {{to}}

failure.token_budget_exceeded: The token budget was used up
failure.ai_unavailable: The AI model was not available
failure.ai_rate_limited: The AI provider asked Keigan to slow down
failure.ai_output_invalid: The AI's reply could not be used

rawDialog.title: Raw AI answer
rawDialog.warning: This is the answer before Keigan's checks. Do not run commands from here; use the checked fix on the Root cause tab.
rawDialog.error: The raw answer could not be loaded.

callsWithoutStep.title: AI calls without a step
callsWithoutStep.description: Calls of this investigation that no step describes: drafts and postmortems written later, or a stage that failed and was rolled back.
